tickets.title: Prepare adjustable-rate mortgage refinance analysis
tickets.text: Prepare the adjustable-rate mortgage refinance analysis for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz using the current Teacup Comet Bank first mortgage balance of $512,400, the estimated post-reset rate near 7.375% with a projected payment increase of about $1,080 per month, the closing-cost estimate, and the household's monthly cash-flow gap. The first mortgage rate is scheduled to reset in May 2024.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that adjustable-rate mortgage refinance analysis by February 23, 2024.

tickets.text: Obtain the Teacup Comet Bank mortgage reset notice, the current January 2024 loan statement, and the original adjustable-rate note for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz. Verify the rate cap language, index, margin, escrow amount, and timing before the refinance analysis is finalized.

tickets.text: Update the household profile for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz with current employment, income, dependent, and family support details. Reflect Lena's move to a four-day workweek at Paper Otter Health Cooperative in January 2024, Dorian's $178,000 base salary and $24,000 prior-year bonus at Moonbadger Systems, the two children ages 14 and 11, and the $600 per month contribution toward Alina Pebblefizz's assisted living costs.

tickets.title: Compare home equity line of credit payoff options
tickets.text: Compare three options for the Teacup Comet Bank home equity line of credit for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz: keep it separate, roll it into the refinance, or use a scheduled principal repayment plan. The current balance is $74,800 at a variable 8.9% rate with interest-only payments of about $555 per month, and the draw period ends in November 2025.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to compare keeping it separate, rolling it into a refinance, or using a scheduled principal repayment plan by February 28, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare credit card payoff sequence
tickets.text: Prepare a payoff order for the three credit cards held by Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz showing interest cost, minimum-payment requirements, and the effect of applying the $900 per month reduced travel and dining spending to the highest-rate card first. The largest balance is $12,900 on a Teacup Comet Bank rewards card at 23.4%, with the other two cards at 19.9% and 21.8%, and combined balances of $22,700.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the credit card payoff sequence by February 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile credit report balance discrepancy

tickets.title: Prepare temporary cash-flow triage budget
tickets.text: Prepare a temporary cash-flow triage budget for Dorian and Lena Pebblefizz identifying spending reductions, debt-payment targets, and a minimum cash reserve guardrail. Incorporate the $30,000 minimum cash level at Velvet Acorn Custody, the possible $900 per month reduction in discretionary travel and dining, the average net pay of about $13,900 per month, and recurring spending averaging about $15,150 per month.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare a temporary cash-flow triage budget by February 26, 2024

tickets.title: Prepare bonus and RSU allocation plan
tickets.text: Prepare a written allocation framework for Dorian Pebblefizz's next Moonbadger Systems bonus and the upcoming restricted stock unit vesting (estimated pre-tax value about $18,500). Balance tax withholding, credit card payoff, cash reserve protection, and possible refinance closing costs.

Address Dorian's concern that RSU withholding may be below the household's marginal tax rate and that withholding will cover less tax than that rate.
